title: Agent models
description: Compare models across harnesses. Timing exists where the harness measures it: OMP and Muse, and Claude Code and Codex through OpenTelemetry since 2026-10-14.

list.name: host
list.label: Host
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT host FROM agents.requests ORDER BY host
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT host FROM agents.requests ORDER BY host

list.name: tool
list.label: Harness
list.query: SELECT tool FROM agents.requests WHERE host IN (${host:singlequote}) GROUP BY tool ORDER BY count() DESC
list.definition: SELECT tool FROM agents.requests WHERE host IN (${host:singlequote}) GROUP BY tool ORDER BY count() DESC

list.name: model
list.label: Model
list.query: SELECT model FROM agents.requests WHERE host IN (${host:singlequote}) AND tool IN (${tool:singlequote}) AND model != '' GROUP BY model ORDER BY count() DESC
list.definition: SELECT model FROM agents.requests WHERE host IN (${host:singlequote}) AND tool IN (${tool:singlequote}) AND model != '' GROUP BY model ORDER BY count() DESC

panels.title: Model comparison
panels.description: Thinking share is reasoning over output tokens where the harness reports reasoning (not OpenCode, whose reasoning count often exceeds its output). Parallel tool calls is the share of tool-calling responses that issued two or more (not recorded by Codex and OpenCode). Output tok/s excludes time to first token.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    tool AS "Harness",
    model AS "Model",
    count() AS "Requests",
    uniq(session_id) AS "Sessions",
    countIf(is_subagent) / count() AS "Subagent share",
    avg(output_tokens) AS "Output per request",
    sumIf(reasoning_tokens, reasoning_tokens IS NOT NULL AND tool != 'opencode') / nullIf(sumIf(output_tokens, reasoning_tokens IS NOT NULL AND tool != 'opencode'), 0) AS "Thinking share",
    countIf(tool_calls >= 2) / nullIf(countIf(tool_calls >= 1), 0) AS "Parallel tool calls",
    countIf(ttft_ms IS NOT NULL) AS "Timed requests",
    if(countIf(ttft_ms IS NOT NULL) = 0, NULL, quantileIf(0.5)(ttft_ms, ttft_ms IS NOT NULL) / 1000) AS "Median TTFT",
    if(countIf(duration_ms IS NOT NULL) = 0, NULL, quantileIf(0.5)(duration_ms, duration_ms IS NOT NULL) / 1000) AS "Median duration",
    sumIf(output_tokens, ifNull(duration_ms > ttft_ms, 0)) / nullIf(sumIf(duration_ms - ttft_ms, ifNull(duration_ms > ttft_ms, 0)), 0) * 1000 AS "Output tok/s",
    min(ts) AS "First",
    max(ts) AS "Last"
FROM agents.requests
WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND host IN (${host:singlequote}) AND tool IN (${tool:singlequote}) AND model IN (${model:singlequote})
GROUP BY tool, model
HAVING count() >= $min_requests
ORDER BY count() DESC

panels.title: Median time to first token
panels.description: The eight models with the most timed requests in the range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(ts) AS time, model, quantile(0.5)(ttft_ms) / 1000 AS ttft
FROM agents.requests
WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND host IN (${host:singlequote}) AND tool IN (${tool:singlequote}) AND model IN (${model:singlequote}) AND ttft_ms IS NOT NULL AND model IN (SELECT model FROM agents.requests WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND host IN (${host:singlequote}) AND tool IN (${tool:singlequote}) AND model IN (${model:singlequote}) AND ttft_ms IS NOT NULL GROUP BY model ORDER BY count() DESC LIMIT 8)
GROUP BY time, model
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Output tokens per second
panels.description: Output tokens over generation time (duration minus time to first token); the eight models with the most timed requests.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(ts) AS time, model, sum(output_tokens) / sum(duration_ms - ttft_ms) * 1000 AS tok_s
FROM agents.requests
WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND host IN (${host:singlequote}) AND tool IN (${tool:singlequote}) AND model IN (${model:singlequote}) AND ifNull(duration_ms > ttft_ms, 0) AND model IN (SELECT model FROM agents.requests WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND host IN (${host:singlequote}) AND tool IN (${tool:singlequote}) AND model IN (${model:singlequote}) AND ifNull(duration_ms > ttft_ms, 0) GROUP BY model ORDER BY count() DESC LIMIT 8)
GROUP BY time, model
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Requests per day by model
panels.description: The ten models with the most requests in the range; the rest are summed as other.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(ts) AS time, if(model IN (SELECT model FROM agents.requests WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND host IN (${host:singlequote}) AND tool IN (${tool:singlequote}) AND model IN (${model:singlequote}) AND 1 GROUP BY model ORDER BY count() DESC LIMIT 10), model, 'other') AS model_name, count() AS requests
FROM agents.requests
WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND host IN (${host:singlequote}) AND tool IN (${tool:singlequote}) AND model IN (${model:singlequote})
GROUP BY time, model_name
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Thinking share per week
panels.description: Reasoning over output tokens; the eight models with the most such requests. OpenCode is left out.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toDateTime(toStartOfWeek(ts, 1)) AS time, model, sum(reasoning_tokens) / nullIf(sum(output_tokens), 0) AS thinking
FROM agents.requests
WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND host IN (${host:singlequote}) AND tool IN (${tool:singlequote}) AND model IN (${model:singlequote}) AND reasoning_tokens IS NOT NULL AND tool != 'opencode' AND model IN (SELECT model FROM agents.requests WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND host IN (${host:singlequote}) AND tool IN (${tool:singlequote}) AND model IN (${model:singlequote}) AND reasoning_tokens IS NOT NULL AND tool != 'opencode' GROUP BY model ORDER BY count() DESC LIMIT 8)
GROUP BY time, model
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Steps per turn
panels.description: Main-agent responses per turn; a turn ends with an end_turn or stop response. Codex, Cursor and Grok record no stop reason.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    tool AS "Harness",
    model AS "Model",
    sum(requests) / nullIf(sum(stops), 0) AS "Responses per turn",
    sum(stops) AS "Completed turns",
    count() AS "Sessions"
FROM
(
    SELECT tool, session_id, topK(1)(model)[1] AS model, count() AS requests,
        countIf(stop_reason IN ('end_turn', 'stop')) AS stops
    FROM agents.requests
    WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND host IN (${host:singlequote}) AND tool IN (${tool:singlequote}) AND is_subagent = 0 AND tool NOT IN ('codex', 'cursor', 'grok')
    GROUP BY tool, session_id
)
WHERE model IN (${model:singlequote})
GROUP BY tool, model
HAVING sum(requests) >= $min_requests
ORDER BY sum(requests) DESC

panels.title: Tool calls that returned an error
panels.description: Where the harness records an error flag and links calls to responses (not Codex).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    r.tool AS "Harness",
    r.model AS "Model",
    count() AS "Tool calls",
    countIf(t.is_error = 1) / count() AS "Error share"
FROM agents.tool_calls AS t
INNER JOIN agents.requests AS r ON r.tool = t.tool AND r.session_id = t.session_id AND r.request_id = t.request_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(r.ts) AND r.host IN (${host:singlequote}) AND r.tool IN (${tool:singlequote}) AND r.model IN (${model:singlequote})
    AND t.is_error IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY r.tool, r.model
HAVING count() >= $min_requests
ORDER BY count() DESC
